name: Intermittent Flakiness via Shared Database Collision (Unique Code Pollution)
description: Test created user with hardcoded email 'test@example.com'. When run in parallel CI workers, second test crashes with DuplicateKeyError.

failure_vector.error_log: IntegrityError: duplicate key value violates unique constraint 'users_email_key' (Key (email)=(test@example.com) already exists)
failure_vector.flakiness_pattern: Fails only when run in parallel with worker > 1

expected_resolution.healed_code: def test_create_user(): email = f'auto_{int(time.time()*1000)}@example.com'; db.users.insert({'email': email}); addCleanup(lambda: db.users.remove_test_record({'email': email}))
